title: tephroseris capitata
intro: Tephroseris capitata, commonly known as the Alpine Saw-wort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, providing potential health benefits such as wound healing and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris capitata include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent to reduce swelling and pain, as well as its potential to prevent the formation of blood clots and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
